bias.en: Uptrend, pulling back · lost $250, testing the $233 lows
bias.zh: 上升趋势中回调 · 失守 $250，测试 $233 一带低点

read.en: Zscaler fell 4.0% on Oct 30 to $237.83, trading between $233.40 and $250.00. It is below the rising 5-day ($252.4) and 10-day ($241.3) averages and above the rising 30-day ($220.9), 100-day ($176.9) and 200-day ($166.9). MACD is still above its signal since Oct 22 and above zero, but the histogram has narrowed toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 22 ($222.39), and RSI is 57.
read.zh: Zscaler 10月30日下跌 4.0%，收于 $237.83，盘中区间 $233.40–250.00。股价位于上行的 5 日（$252.4）和 10 日均线（$241.3）下方，位于上行的 30 日（$220.9）、100 日（$176.9）和 200 日均线（$166.9）上方。MACD 自 10月22日起仍在信号线上方且在零轴之上，但柱状图收窄、趋向交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看多（$222.39），RSI 为 57。

read.en: Two down days broke all three written supports, $253.9–255.6, $250 and $241.2 (Oct 22 high), now resistance. Resistance is $241.2–241.3 (Oct 22 high, 10-day), then $250–252.4 (round number, 5-day) and $261.5 (Oct 26 high). Support is $231.6–234.2 (Oct 22, 23, 29 and 30 lows), then $220.9–222.4 (30-day, SAR) and $203.3 (Oct 16 low). A close above $241.3 would target $250–252; below $231.6, $221–222.
